title: Next-Charge Reserve on Paloma Business Withdrawals
content:
A next-charge reserve is kept back from a withdrawal of a Paloma Business balance for the subscription charge of the next billing period, decided by the calendar days from the day of the withdrawal to the next billing day, the day after the last day of the current period.

| Calendar days from the day of the withdrawal to the next billing day | Next-charge reserve |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | The plan's monthly fee |
| 8 to 14 | Half the plan's monthly fee, rounded half up to the cent |
| More than 14 | Nothing |

As a clause: 7 days or fewer keep back the plan's monthly fee; 8 to 14 days keep back half the plan's monthly fee, rounded half up to the cent; more than 14 days keep back nothing. The next-charge reserve is not withdrawable.

### Dated cases (hypothetical; current period ends 30 June, next billing day 1 July)

| Day of the withdrawal | Days to 1 July | Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| 24 June | 7 | The monthly fee |
| 23 June | 8 | Half the monthly fee |
| 17 June | 14 | Half the monthly fee |
| 16 June | 15 | Nothing |

### Half the monthly fee by plan

| Plan | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Half the monthly fee (USD) | 0.00 | 9.50 | 24.50 | 64.50 | 149.50 | 374.50 |
